papers.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
papers.desc: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations.

papers.title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
papers.desc: Video generation is progressing beyond isolated clips toward long-form narratives and interactive worlds, requiring models to preserve identities, follow user controls, and remain stable over extended rollouts.

papers.title: Video-IFBench: Evaluating Instruction Following of Multimodal LLMs in Video Understanding Scenarios
papers.desc: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong performance in video understanding.

papers.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
papers.desc: Modern software systems accumulate technical debt over decades of development, which makes migration expensive and largely manual.

papers.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents
papers.desc: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits.

papers.title: Rubrics as Visual-Repair Context for Self-Evolving UI-to-Code Generation
papers.desc: Large vision-language models have shown strong progress in UI-to-code generation, yet their test-time self-evolution remains unstable.

papers.title: Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling
papers.desc: The development of 0.1^{circ} global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25^{circ} resolution.

papers.title: Skill Issue: Are Skills Language-Invariant in LLMs?
papers.desc: Large language models access knowledge inconsistently across languages, but to what extent do they differ in their skill sets when interacting with different languages? This work quantifies cross-lingual skill inconsistency orthogonally from knowledge and general benchmark performance.

papers.title: Prefix Sliding for efficient test-time scaling
papers.desc: Test-time scaling uses extra test-time compute to improve performance, such as letting language models reason longer when solving a problem.

papers.title: RetrievalRouter: Joint Modality and Architecture Selection for Document Retrieval
papers.desc: Document retrieval increasingly supports high-stakes information access in finance, healthcare, and law.

papers.title: FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling
papers.desc: Reliable reward models are essential for text-to-video evaluation and alignment.

papers.title: LibriBrain100: One Hundred Hours of Broad and Deep MEG Data for Neural Speech Decoding at Scale
papers.desc: We introduce LibriBrain100, a large-scale MEG dataset for speech decoding designed from the ground up for reproducible, standardised evaluation.

papers.title: A Modular Agent for Reliable and Auditable Spatial Relation Verification in CT Scans
papers.desc: Reliable spatial understanding is an important prerequisite for future medical vision-language systems that aim to support radiological report generation and structured image understanding.

papers.title: GUI-Primitives: Diagnosing Spatial Reasoning Failures in Vision-Language GUI Grounding
papers.desc: Computer-use agents ground natural-language instructions in screenshots to locate interface elements, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether models bind relational language to the correct element.

papers.title: Real-TurnTurk: A Multimodal Turkish Corpus for Turn-Taking Prediction
papers.desc: Turn-taking is a basic organizational feature of human conversation and remains difficult to model in natural, synchronous dialog systems.
